name: Goldlink Internet
summary: Gold Coast nationwide dialup ISP (Goldlink Designs, ~2001); defunct (GOLDLINK INTERNET SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 098 219 759).

events.details: Defunct. Last retail ISP homepage Aug 2007; Goldlink-branded web-dev firm (c) 2008 by Sep 2009 - proposal's c. 2008 fits; company continued as non-ISP which does not extend death. domain repurposed to web development.

refs.label: Aug 2007: still a live retail ISP (internet plans, phone, webmail).
By Sep 2009 the domain is purely a web-design firm; its 2008 copyright stamp points to a 2008 pivot (capture-free gap Aug 2007-Sep 2009).
